$comment: The course notice boards (docs/specs/COURSE-BOARDS.md, docs/content-data.md): which chapter each island's board shows, where it stands, its header and pins, and which ## sections aren't topics. The topics themselves come from content/course.lock.json, so the weekly course sync keeps them current. Loaded at build time by src/content/course-boards.ts; checked by src/content/content.test.ts and `npm run content:check`. In the text, {num} is the chapter's number ("01") and {title} its title in the course.

anchorage.where: East side of the street from the quay up to the village square, turned toward the pier foot, so it's in view as you come ashore.

meridian.where: Against the harbour wall at the back of the quay, between two palms, facing the water. You pass it walking from the east arm to the stair street, well clear of the plaza.

thousand-bough.where: Bough Landing's east side, facing back up the wharf: you see it as you walk ashore, before the Fern Walk.
